3.4a — Turret Damage, Tuning & Playtest

The turret works. Working is not the same as fun. Today you turn "it shoots" into "I want to try again" — with the tuning process designers actually use, and the playtest that proves it.

Build Lab ~20 min

The turret's difficulty lives in exactly four numbers, and you own all of them now:

Knob (lives on)DefaultTurns into
maxAttackRange (turret)7How much of the room is dangerous
attackCooldown (turret)2sHow much time between chances to dodge
speed (projectile prefab)10How much reaction time you get
damage (projectile prefab)1How much a mistake costs

Step 1 — the tuning matrix. Try three turret personalities in one scene (three turrets, different knobs): a SNIPER (long range, slow shots, fast bullets), a SPRAYER (short range, fast shots), and a FLAK (medium range, slow big bullets, damage 2). Write the four numbers for each before you test — tune with a hypothesis, not a vibe.

Step 2 — difficulty curves. Place the three so the player meets SPRAYER first, FLAK second, SNIPER last. That ramp — easy threat, medium threat, precision threat — is a difficulty curve built from copies of one prefab. You will reuse this exact idea at scale in 7.5a, when the whole cave is a curve.

Bug Hunt: The unfair-feeling fight

  1. Build a turret the player CANNOT dodge: range 12, cooldown 0.2, speed 20. Play it. What is the difference between HARD and IMPOSSIBLE, in one sentence each?
  2. Now make one that LOOKS scary but is dodgeable (range 10, cooldown 1, speed 6). Which numbers make fear — and which make failure?
  3. Set projectile damage to 3 with default everything else. What does one hit do to the whole game's health economy (remember: max 3)?
Playtest ~25 min

Swap seats (2.4a rules: tester plays and talks, designer watches silently). Watch for the three tells:

  • Never approached — the radius reads as a wall. Shrink range or telegraph it.
  • Tanked on purpose — bullets cost less than the detour. Raise damage or place coins on the safe path.
  • Died the same way twice — the failure is unclear. Slower bullets, louder fire moment.

Tinker: Close the loop

  1. Write your top-3 fixes from your partner's run, then apply exactly one. Re-run the partner. Did the tell change? One variable at a time is how you learn WHICH change mattered.
  2. Where in YOUR overworld should the first turret go — before or after the potion? Defend it in two sentences using health economy, not taste.
  3. Commit + push: "3.4a: turret personalities + tuning matrix".

Checkpoint — before moving on, you must be able to:

  • Name the four difficulty knobs and what each controls in play
  • Design three distinct turret personalities from one prefab
  • Explain hard vs impossible vs scary, with numbers
  • Run a silent playtest, pick the top fix, apply exactly one
